definition_zh: 癌症；恶性肿瘤；社会毒瘤
definition_en: a serious disease in which cells grow in an uncontrolled way
core_image: 身体里不受控地增生的细胞
scene: 她陪父亲去医院复查。The doctor explained how cancer spreads.
sceneCN: 这里 cancer 是「癌症」（第 1 个义项：细胞失控增生的疾病）；句意是医生解释了癌症如何扩散。

pos.zh: 名词：社会毒瘤，蔓延的弊端

derivatives.zh: 癌性的，像癌一样蔓延的

senses.title: The disease of uncontrolled cells
senses.definition: a disease in which abnormal cells divide without control
senses.definitionCN: 异常细胞不受控制地分裂增生的疾病
senses.example: The doctor explained how cancer spreads.
senses.exampleCN: 医生解释了癌症如何扩散。
senses.why: The core image is a growth spreading through the body like a crab's legs.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是像蟹足一样在体内蔓延的肿块。

senses.title: A spreading social evil
senses.definition: a harmful practice that spreads through a society
senses.definitionCN: 在社会中蔓延的有害现象
senses.example: Greed is a cancer in the system.
senses.exampleCN: 贪婪是体制里的一颗毒瘤。
senses.why: A disease that spreads became a picture for any spreading harm.
senses.whyCN: 会扩散的疾病，被用来比喻任何蔓延的祸害。

intro.en: Cancer is the Latin word for crab, given to tumours that spread like claws.
intro.cn: cancer 是拉丁语里的「螃蟹」，因肿瘤蔓延像蟹足而得名。

items.en: karkinos meant crab and also named such tumours.
items.cn: 希腊语 karkinos 意为螃蟹，也用来指这类肿瘤。

items.en: cancer meant crab and took over the medical sense.
items.cn: 拉丁语 cancer 意为螃蟹，并承接了医学义。

items.en: cancer appears in early medical writing.
items.cn: 古英语的医学文献中已出现 cancer。

items.en: The word was fixed for malignant growths.
items.cn: 十七世纪起固定指恶性肿瘤。

items.en: Cancer names the disease and any spreading evil.
items.cn: 现代英语中 cancer 兼指这种疾病与蔓延的祸害。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cancer base; the near-meaning group gives related medical words.
note.cn: 形近组共用 cancer 词基；近义组是相关的医学词。

entries.definition: a substance that can cause cancer
of a growth, likely to spread and be dangerous

normalIntro.en: Cancer is Latin for crab, a picture of claws spreading.
normalIntro.cn: cancer 是拉丁语的螃蟹，取蟹足蔓延之象。

normal.en: Lung cancer is a common phrase.
The word also means a spreading evil.
normal.cn: 这个词也指蔓延的祸害。

abstract.en: See a crab's legs reaching across a page.
See cells dividing again and again.
See a dark stain spreading through cloth.
abstract.cn: 想象污渍在布上不断扩散。

examples.en: The doctor explained how cancer spreads.
examples.cn: 医生解释了癌症如何扩散。

examples.en: She lost her uncle to lung cancer.
Greed is a cancer in the system.
examples.cn: 贪婪是体制里的一颗毒瘤。

dict_mnemonic.text: cancer 的 can 像螃蟹的钳子，cer 像横着爬的脚，钳子一张一合，正是螃蟹也是癌的拉丁名。

root: cancer 直接借自拉丁语 cancer（螃蟹），对应希腊语 karkinos；古代医生见肿瘤周围血管如蟹足伸展，便用螃蟹命名这种病。

sensesIntro.en: The disease of spreading cells, and any spreading social harm.
sensesIntro.cn: 细胞扩散的疾病，以及任何蔓延的社会祸害。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: claws reaching outward through tissue.
core.cn: 核心意象：蟹足在组织里向外伸展。

intro.en: Cancer forms an adjective with -ous and technical words with carcin-.
intro.cn: cancer 能加 -ous 构成形容词，也能用 carcin- 构成专业词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin cancer, a crab.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 cancer，意为螃蟹。

items.meaning: the basic unit of the body
